description: VERDA Hydrating Conditioner is a two-minute conditioner made with aloe, oat and rice protein for anyone who wants a conditioner that detangles without weigh-down. The formula pairs aloe barbadensis leaf juice and avena sativa (oat) kernel extract with hydrolyzed rice protein and panthenol in a creamy conditioning base, finished with fragrance. Use it after shampooing: apply to clean, wet hair, leave 2 min, rinse. It comes in a 400 mL / 13.5 fl oz sage green bottle with a white flip-top cap that opens easily with one hand in the shower. For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse well with water.
